reviewNotes: GPT-6 AI editorial review of 32 original low-typing questions. Reviewed full German sentence and inflected separable verbs, all offered choices, keys, bilingual feedback, hints and distinct contexts. Sixteen rows authored; four deferred for likely CEFR mismatches or ambiguous/overlapping senses. Corrected inherited gloss/example conflicts for antreten, anzeigen and aufführen without copying legacy sentences. Source levels are not CEFR certification. No independent human review, rights certification or measured transfer; publication remains false and target reviews pending.
